Wasim Jaffer Explains Virat Kohli's Test Retirement Amid Handling Concerns

Former Indian cricketer Wasim Jaffer stated that Virat Kohli was unhappy with how his decision to retire from Test cricket was handled. Jaffer suggested that Kohli was preparing for the England tour and could have continued playing Test cricket. Jaffer also raised questions about the selection committee's treatment of senior players.
